description: Golden image security and first-boot contract
steps: Verify the pi account contains only the approved SSH key
Confirm root and password SSH login are disabled
Verify unattended Noble and Armbian updates include kernel and firmware packages
Check host identity and cloud-init state are clean in the image
Verify K3s remains disabled until enrolment files exist
Confirm no cluster address, token, or fixed K3S_DATA partition is baked in
Verify first boot derives the hostname from a usable Ethernet MAC address
Confirm host keys and machine identity are regenerated on first boot
Verify first-boot paths do not download keys or start K3s
Confirm site-specific addressing remains outside the image
Validate the one-shot cloud-init hostname action
Confirm Docker uses ARM64 with at least 8 GiB RAM and 50 GiB free disk
Build the pinned Armbian checkout with mise run provisioning:build
Verify the build uses the K3s version declared by both Flux upgrade plans
Confirm the compact image grows its root filesystem on first boot
Verify the canonical set contains an img.xz file, SHA-256 sidecar, and JSON manifest
Confirm the sidecar and manifest identify the same image filename
Verify the manifest records the exact K3s binary and air-gap payload hashes
Confirm the verifier rejects any version or security regression

description: Flash a verified golden image to Radxa media
steps: Verify the local artifact set before selecting a device
Confirm the target is a whole disk that does not contain the running system
Reject devices with mounted child partitions or insufficient capacity
Require the exact validated device path as typed confirmation
Flash a real Radxa device and confirm it boots

description: Stage and publish canonical golden image artifacts
steps: Validate the three-file artifact set before distribution
Stage the exact set under the release ID on the NAS
Publish the same files to a GitHub release tagged with the release ID
Confirm no token, cluster address, or private key appears in published artifacts
Validate the node name and SSH target before mutation
Drain the node while respecting disruption budgets
Stop and disable K3s before deleting the Kubernetes node
Remove local K3s configuration, token, and state
Confirm remaining cluster nodes and workloads are healthy
Verify the Armbian build targets rock-5b-plus and Noble minimal userspace
Validate the ARM64 K3s binary and air-gap archive
Test boot from the intended removable or NVMe media
Confirm the NVMe rescan hook handles affected Crucial P310 drives
Verify first-boot hostname and SSH access
Check thermal, storage, and network operation
Enrol the host and confirm the node becomes Ready
Define VLAN IDs for each network segment
Document IP allocation for all nodes
Verify the matching image, checksum, manifest, server token, and snapshot are available offline
Flash and boot one seed host without automatic K3s startup
Install reviewed server configuration and token out of band
Restore the matching etcd snapshot when required
Confirm the API ready endpoint, recovered nodes, and workloads before further enrolment

description: Explicit SSH enrolment into a healthy cluster
steps: Verify the target is clean, dormant, and reachable as pi with sudo
Select a Ready control-plane source node
Copy sanitised shared K3s configuration and the token without printing it
Write configuration and token with mode 0600 before enabling K3s
Confirm the new node becomes Ready and joins etcd
Retire or confirm the previous node is safely offline
Run enrolment with the explicit replace option
Verify the stale Kubernetes node object is removed
Confirm the replacement node registers with the expected hostname
Validate workloads reschedule and the cluster remains healthy
Drain and retire the old node with mise run provisioning:retire
Verify data migration or replica health where needed
Flash a verified golden image to replacement media
Enrol the replacement explicitly over SSH
Confirm workloads reschedule and the cluster remains healthy
Verify every documented provisioning command is discoverable with mise tasks
Check each command accepts its documented help and arguments
Exercise non-mutating build, flash, enrol, retire, stage, release, and cleanup dry runs
Confirm secret values are redacted from output
Validate Mise entry points and the shared Go command with Bash orchestration
Inspect node and host state with provisioning:status
Enrol a clean flashed host into an existing healthy cluster
Replace a stale same-name node only with the explicit replace option
Retire a node after typed confirmation
Confirm errors stop before partial mutation and never disclose the cluster token
Inspect Docker and Armbian disk usage
Purge only resources owned by the pinned Armbian build
Never invoke global Docker prune operations
Require explicit opt-in before Docker Desktop space reclamation
Remove the legacy Lima instance only through the separately confirmed one-time task
Check build, verification, flashing, enrolment, status, retirement, staging, release, and cleanup commands
Validate Docker, disk-space, hardware, and healthy-cluster prerequisites
Test the runbook on a new Radxa node
Confirm zero-cluster recovery and NVMe troubleshooting are documented
